dialogues.jp:
なんだか、｛まぶた／瞼｝の向こうがさっきから明るい気が
する。
dialogues.en: I felt the brightness through my eyelids.
dialogues.text: I felt the brightness through my eyelids.

dialogues.jp: 今、何時だ？
dialogues.en: What time is it now?
dialogues.text: What time is it now?

dialogues.jp: 目をうっすらと開け、時計をみる。
dialogues.en: I slightly opened my eyes and looked at the clock.
dialogues.text: I slightly opened my eyes and looked at the clock.

dialogues.jp: ……２時……午後か。

dialogues.en: "......Aaaaaaw."
dialogues.text: "......Aaaaaaw."

dialogues.jp:
身体を起こし、脳に酸素を送る。まさかお昼を
過ぎていようとは。
dialogues.en:
I woke up and sent some oxygen into my brain. I didn't think
it was already past noon.
dialogues.text:
I woke up and sent some oxygen into my brain. I didn't think
it was already past noon.

dialogues.jp: （昨夜はいろいろなことがあったからな……）
dialogues.en: (Last night was pretty rough......)
dialogues.text: (Last night was pretty rough......)

dialogues.jp: 唇をそっと触ってみる。
dialogues.en: Although, I was pretty much lying down the whole time......
dialogues.text: Although, I was pretty much lying down the whole time......

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩の柔らかい唇の感触が、まだ残っている
ように思い出される。
dialogues.en: The traces from last night were clearly left on my bed.
dialogues.text: The traces from last night were clearly left on my bed.

dialogues.jp: 「……やば、顔がにやけてきた」
dialogues.en: I lost my virginity......
dialogues.text: I lost my virginity......

dialogues.jp: とりあえず、起きてシャワーを浴びたい。
dialogues.en: "......Shoot, I'm still smiling."
dialogues.text: "......Shoot, I'm still smiling."

dialogues.jp:
（先輩が起こしに来ないところをみると、まだ
　寝てるのかな？）
dialogues.en: I want to take a shower first of all.
dialogues.text: I want to take a shower first of all.

dialogues.jp:
考えつつ、ベッドから起き出して、部屋を出る
べくドアを開ける。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai should still be asleep in her room. She must be
several times more tired than I am.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai should still be asleep in her room. She must be
several times more tired than I am.

dialogues.en: I slowly got out of the bed.
dialogues.text: I slowly got out of the bed.

dialogues.jp: ドアを出てすぐの廊下に、萌先輩が眠っていた。
床に寝転がり、すやすやと寝息を立てている。
dialogues.en: When I got out of the bed, Moe-sempai was still sleeping.
dialogues.text: When I got out of the bed, Moe-sempai was still sleeping.

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩ッ」
dialogues.en: She was lying on the floor, and snoring peacefully.
dialogues.text: She was lying on the floor, and snoring peacefully.

dialogues.jp: うっすらと瞼が開く。
dialogues.en: She slightly opened her eyes.
dialogues.text: She slightly opened her eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「んん……ふぁ……ふぅ……」
目をこすりながら、むくりと起き上がる。
dialogues.en: She woke up and rubbed her eyes.
dialogues.text: She woke up and rubbed her eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くん、おはようございます」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「部屋に戻ったんじゃ、なかったんですか？」
dialogues.en: "You didn't go back to your room?"
dialogues.text: "You didn't go back to your room?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 俺の言葉にきょろきょろとあたりを見回す。
dialogues.en: She looked around as I spoke.
dialogues.text: She looked around as I spoke.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「廊下ですね……」
dialogues.en: "This is your room......"
dialogues.text: "This is your room......"

dialogues.jp: きょとんと不思議そうに首を傾げる萌先輩。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai tilted her head with a surprised face. I guess
she fell asleep when she was trying to go back to her room.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai tilted her head with a surprised face. I guess
she fell asleep when she was trying to go back to her room.

dialogues.jp:
やはり、戻る途中でスリープモードになってし
まったらしい。
dialogues.en: "Weren't you cold?"
dialogues.text: "Weren't you cold?"

dialogues.jp: 「寒くなかったですか？」
dialogues.en:
It's spring time now, but it should still be too cold to
sleep without any blanket.
dialogues.text:
It's spring time now, but it should still be too cold to
sleep without any blanket.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと、寒かったです」
dialogues.en: "It was kind of cold."
dialogues.text: "It was kind of cold."

dialogues.jp:
自分の身体を確認するように触りながら、よう
やく答える。
dialogues.en: She answered as she touched her own body.
dialogues.text: She answered as she touched her own body.

dialogues.jp:
「とにかくシャワーでも浴びて、暖まったほう
　がいいですね」
dialogues.en: "You need to take a shower and warm up."
dialogues.text: "You need to take a shower and warm up."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね。行ってきます……」
dialogues.en: "You're right. I shall go now......"
dialogues.text: "You're right. I shall go now......"

dialogues.jp: くるりと振り返り、てくてくと歩いていく。
dialogues.en: She turned around and started walking.
dialogues.text: She turned around and started walking.

dialogues.en:
The way she walked seemed so awkward...... it made me
extremely shy.
dialogues.text:
The way she walked seemed so awkward...... it made me
extremely shy.

dialogues.jp: ◆スリープモード◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sleep mode◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sleep mode◆

dialogues.jp: 目が覚め、ベッド脇の階段を下りる。
dialogues.en: I woke up and got out of bed.
dialogues.text: I woke up and got out of bed.

dialogues.jp:
と、そこで、途中でスリープモードになったら
しい萌先輩が倒れていた。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai was lying on my floor, after she fell asleep on
her way back to her room last night.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai was lying on my floor, after she fell asleep on
her way back to her room last night.
